variants.title: 01 紧凑横排
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high-fidelity UI redesign concept of the attached AIO Life walking activity card. Input image is the content and dark visual identity reference. Flat straight-on digital UI screenshot, landscape 3:2 canvas, charcoal black backdrop, one rounded dark graphite card centered, crisp Chinese system typography, restrained blue action accent and the SAME lime walking pictogram on muted navy rounded-square tile as reference. Preserve only the existing business content: “第1组”, “散步”, a navigation chevron, “0 次”, and a save action. Do not add charts, goals, dates, descriptions, fields, plus/minus controls or invented business content. Modern implementable app design, deliberate compact spacing, no phone frame, no perspective, no glass, no gradients, no decorative illustrations, no watermark. Include the variant number and short Chinese concept title above the card as an external design-board label, clearly separate from product UI.
Variant: 01 紧凑横排
Make a notably COMPACT low-height horizontal card: small 第1组 eyebrow upper left; main row contains walking tile, bold 散步 and chevron on left; 0 次 in muted white right; small square blue save button at far right with crisp white floppy-disk outline icon, no word label on this icon action. All main row items aligned, minimal vertical whitespace. Card width roughly 85% canvas and height 32%.
